blocks.text: MANILA – The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) on Wednesday awarded a PHP12.3-million jackpot prize to the winner of the Oct. 2, 2014 Lotto 6/42 draw, whose winning ticket was partially blackened by a hot iron. The payout to Antonio Mendoza followed a final Supreme Court ruling and authorization from the Commission on Audit (COA). “PCSO has a duty to protect the integrity of the lottery and to pay winners what they are legally owed. In Mr. Mendoza’s case, the Supreme Court determined what was due, and the Commission on Audit authorized payment. Today, we are carrying out those decisions,” PCSO […]...
